review.tagline: Multimodal agent stack: terminal/Web UI agent and a desktop GUI agent
review.summary: Monorepo with two projects. Agent TARS is a CLI and Web UI agent that controls a browser via GUI vision, DOM, or a hybrid, and mounts MCP servers as tools. UI-TARS Desktop is an app that operates the local or a remote computer and browser through the UI-TARS and Seed-1.5-VL/1.6 vision-language models.
review.audience: Developers wanting GUI and browser-operating agents driven by vision models
strengths: Browser control by GUI vision, DOM, or hybrid strategy
MCP kernel; external MCP servers can be mounted as tools
Agent TARS runs headful (Web UI) or headless as a server
Works with providers such as Volcengine and Anthropic via CLI flags
weaknesses: Two products in one repo; README splits setup across external docs
Desktop app targets Windows and macOS; Linux support not stated
RAM and GPU needs for local UI-TARS models are not stated
Agent TARS CLI requires Node.js 22 or newer
needs: Needs Node.js >= 22, model provider API key
Models: UI-TARS-1.5, Seed-1.5-VL, Volcengine Doubao, Anthropic Claude
